lines.text: The prophets Haggai and Zechariah prophesied, and Zerubbabel and Jeshua rose up and began rebuilding God's house in Jerusalem.
Tattenai the governor and Shethar-bozenai asked the Jews who authorized the rebuilding and asked for the names of the builders.
God's eye was on the elders, so the work continued while Tattenai sent a letter to King Artaxerxes.
Nebuchadnezzar destroyed the temple, and Cyrus gave the gold and silver articles to Mordecai, whom he appointed governor.
Sheshbazzar laid the foundation, and Tattenai asked the king to search the royal archives in Babylon for Cyrus's decree.
